column1: # What packs the AppImage (PLATFORM-013), each a release download pinned by
# its SHA-256: the AppImage runtime the file starts with, one per
# architecture it is made for (static, so the machine needs no libfuse), and
# appimagetool, one per architecture it runs on. linux/appimage/fetch_tools.sh
# fetches them and fails on any other bytes. Columns: file, URL, SHA-256.
